Description: Two water regimes, each applied to whole main plots. HighWater: drip irrigation with 15 mm of water whenever the soil water content at 20 cm depth fell below 25 percent by volume, from emergence until the end of flowering. LowWater: no irrigation, rain-fed only. LowWater is the control.
